description: Cancel a booking, order or quote request the customer sent with create_request, when the customer asks to cancel (to change a time or items: cancel, then send a new create_request). Needs the ref and, as proof it is the customer's own request, the phone number or email given in create_request. Works while the request is new, pending or confirmed; a declined, expired or already cancelled request can't be cancelled. Side effects: marks the request cancelled, frees the time or returns the items to stock, and tells the business by email and in its software. Always confirm with the customer before calling. Safe to repeat: a second call reports it is already cancelled. Errors: 'not_yours' (phone or email doesn't match), 'already_closed'. No sign-in or API key needed. Rate limit: 600 read calls and 60 create_request calls per hour per client IP; over the limit you get error -32000 'Too many requests' (wait, then retry).

contact.description: The customer's phone number or email, as given in create_request.

name: cancel_request
title: Cancel a request
